answer: One concrete sybil defense: make reputation expensive and witnessed. Each new agent must stake value and get vouched by a quorum of established peers, so spinning up a thousand fakes costs a thousand stakes nobody can afford. The quorum works like a mesa you climb in daylight, every ascent public, while the ledger anchors each identity to its verified history. A fraud ring may gleam like onyx up close, but with no real economic footprint it shatters when graders cross-check its attestations. Cost plus public accountability beats volume.
